name: Lopaa
author: sulopatech

sections.description:
Lopaa is an advanced AI chatbot plugin that transforms your WordPress website into a professional customer service platform. Designed specifically for WooCommerce stores, Lopaa provides intelligent, automated customer support that operates 24/7.

Key Features

  • Advanced AI-powered conversation engine for natural customer interactions
  • Deep WooCommerce integration with direct access to order information
  • 24/7 automated customer support reduces manual workload
  • Simple configuration through WordPress admin dashboard
  • Enterprise-grade security with encrypted data transmission
  • Customizable appearance to match your brand identity

Business Benefits

  • Reduce customer support tickets and response times
  • Improve customer satisfaction with instant responses
  • Increase sales through intelligent product recommendations
  • Collect valuable customer feedback automatically
  • Scale customer support without additional staff

Ideal For

  • E-commerce businesses using WooCommerce
  • Online stores seeking to automate customer service
  • Websites requiring 24/7 customer engagement
  • Businesses looking to improve operational efficiency

Lopaa integrates seamlessly with your existing WordPress and WooCommerce infrastructure, requiring minimal technical knowledge for implementation and maintenance.

External Services

This plugin connects to the Lopaa API service to provide chatbot functionality and authentication.

Service: Lopaa API (api-support-system.sulopa.com)
Purpose: Plugin authentication, chatbot functionality, and order data retrieval for customer support
Data Sent:
– During activation: Your website URL and admin email address
– During operation: Customer order information (when requested through chatbot)
When: On plugin activation and when users interact with the chatbot

Privacy and Terms:
– Terms of Service: https://lopaa.io/terms-conditions/
– Privacy Policy: https://lopaa.io/privacy-policy

This connection is required for the plugin to function. No data is sent without your explicit activation of the plugin or user interaction with the chatbot.

Contact

For support or inquiries,
please contact Sulopa Technologies Pvt Ltd at hello@sulopa.com or visit https://sulopa.com.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)
1. Navigate to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin dashboard
2. Search for “Lopaa”
3. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
4. Complete the setup wizard that appears after activation

Manual Installation
1. Download the plugin files from the WordPress repository
2. Upload the lopaa folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory via FTP
3. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress admin
4. Navigate to Lopaa Settings to configure your chatbot

After Installation
1. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and activated (required dependency)
2. Go to Lopaa Settings in your WordPress admin menu
3. Enter your API credentials provided by Lopaa.io
4. Configure chatbot appearance and behavior settings
5. Test the chatbot functionality on your website frontend

Configuration Requirements
* Valid Lopaa.io account and API credentials
* WooCommerce plugin installed and activated
* WordPress admin access for initial setup
sections.faq:
What is Lopaa?

Lopaa is an advanced AI chatbot plugin specifically designed for WordPress websites with WooCommerce integration. It provides intelligent, automated customer support that operates 24/7, helping businesses reduce support workload while improving customer satisfaction.

Is WooCommerce required?

Yes, WooCommerce is a required dependency. Lopaa integrates deeply with WooCommerce to access order information and provide comprehensive customer support related to purchases, shipping, and account management.

How do I get API credentials?

After purchasing Lopaa, you will receive API credentials via email. You can also access your credentials by logging into your account at Lopaa.io. These credentials are required for plugin activation and functionality.

Is my customer data secure?

Yes, Lopaa employs enterprise-grade security measures. All data transmission is encrypted, and customer information is handled according to strict privacy standards. Review our privacy policy at https://lopaa.io/privacy-policy for complete details.

Can I customize the chatbot appearance?

Yes, Lopaa provides customization options to match your brand identity. You can adjust colors, positioning, messaging, and behavior through the WordPress admin settings panel.

Does the chatbot work on mobile devices?

Yes, Lopaa is fully responsive and optimized for all devices including smartphones and tablets, ensuring consistent customer experience across all platforms.

Can I use Lopaa on multiple websites?

The plugin is licensed for use on a single website as specified in your purchase agreement. For multiple website licensing or enterprise solutions, contact hello@sulopa.com for pricing and availability.

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

When deactivated, the chatbot will no longer appear on your website. Your configuration settings are preserved, so reactivation restores full functionality without requiring reconfiguration.

Do you provide technical support?

Yes, we provide comprehensive technical support for all Lopaa customers. Contact our support team at hello@sulopa.com for assistance with installation, configuration, or troubleshooting.
